hypothesis: Executing env.DB.batch with over 100 statements from a large Google Maps list exceeds Cloudflare D1 transaction limits and throws fatal exception. Statements must be strictly chunked to <= 90 statements per batch.
Accepting unverified X-User-ID without strict RFC 4122 UUIDv4 validation or falling back to 'guest-session' allows cross-tenant data pollution and unauthorized overwrite of personal places.

Forwarding request directly to env.POI_SERVICE consumes the Request Body stream. If POI service fails and fallback is attempted without request.clone(), the second fetch throws 'TypeError: Body has already been used', defeating zero-downtime resilience.
Missing composite index on (user_id, created_at DESC) causes D1 to execute full table scans for user queries, rapidly exhausting the daily 5,000,000 row read quota under legitimate traffic.
